text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
I'm totally fine with this, though~ You 
worry way too much, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Look, jumping up and down like this is 
totally fine!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Right?! Feel relieved now?

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Stay still, huh... Hmm, okay! I don't 
wanna make you worry, after all.

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: ...*gasp* Phew!!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
*pant*... *pant*... Staying still sure is 
hard, huh...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Telling them they didn't need to go as far 
as holding their breath, they had them 
rest quietly.

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Ouch... W-Why are you so mad? Look, it 
really doesn't hurt at all, see...?
choice_data_list:
Because I'm serious about making you take 
1st place.

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Trainer...!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Got it! I'll be careful! No more hopping 
around!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Gotta be careful! Is there anything 
dangerous around here, I wonder?! Anything 
that looks painful—

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
...H-Huh? Come to think of it, my toe has 
kind of been hurting for a while...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
That jump from earlier was likely the 
cause... After tending to the new injury, 
she was given the rest of the day to rest.

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
I promise! Whether I'm running or 
studying, I'll be careful!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: So... let's train!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Doing big stretches or watching races 
won't get you hurt, I think!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Because, you see... I'm truly aiming for 
1st place too!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
That's why I want to show Trainer that I 
can properly be careful!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Trusting Haru Urara's words, we resumed 
training after treating her injury.
